products.name: Matt:e Single Phase PEN Fault Protection and 40 or 100A MCB (Component only)
description: The Matt:e Single Phase PEN Fault Protection Unit (SKU: MTE/A 11-100M1A 3P) is a dedicated, single-connection O-PEN isolation and circuit protection enclosure supplied by Ocunio, engineered specifically to simplify BS 7671 compliance for single-phase EV chargepoints installed on PME (Protective Multiple Earthing) networks. Incorporating Matt:e’s patented O-PEN® technology, the unit continuously monitors the incoming supply and automatically disconnects all poles—including live, neutral, and the circuit protective conductor (CPC)—in the event of a broken or open PEN conductor fault, eliminating the need to drive external earth electrodes or risk striking buried utility services.

Designed for versatile domestic and light commercial integration, the unit is equipped with a heavy-duty 40A or 100A single-pole-plus-neutral/3-pole switching MCB (dependent on variant configuration), providing robust overcurrent and short-circuit safeguarding alongside complete electrical isolation. Housed in a durable, compact mild steel enclosure, it facilitates fast, tidy wall mounting adjacent to consumer units or dedicated EV distribution boards without requiring complex civil works or time-consuming earth resistance testing.

Engineered to meet the strict requirements of BS 7671:2018+A2:2022 (Regulation 722.411.4.1), this standalone unit provides an immediate, reliable earthing solution for EV chargers that lack built-in PEN fault detection, ensuring contractors can deliver fast, fully compliant installations with complete peace of mind.

Incorporating next-generation IET:01:2024 Category M1b3t PEN fault protection, the unit continuously supervises supply voltage (184V to 262.2V window) and protective conductor current (tripping at the 21mA threshold), simultaneously disconnecting Line, Neutral, and Earth (PE) in the event of a fault. While a complete grid power interruption triggers automatic reconnection after a 20-second stability check, any detected PEN, voltage, or protective conductor fault requires manual inspection and reset for maximum user safety.

Housed in a durable, top-hinged IP41 indoor-rated mild steel enclosure (302 × 235 × 124mm), it provides a neat, regulation-ready termination point ideal for garages, utility rooms, cross-pavement setups, and Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) installations. Engineered to facilitate full compliance with BS 7671:2018+A2:2022 (Regulation 722.411.4.1 (iv)) and IET:01:2024, it enables electrical contractors to complete installations quickly, cleanly, and safely.
